content: Researchers have highlighted several drivers for the diffusion of such malicious phenomenon, which include human factors (confirmation bias BIBREF4, naive realism BIBREF5), algorithmic biases (filter bubble effect BIBREF0), the presence of deceptive agents on social platforms (bots and trolls BIBREF6) and, lastly, the formation of echo chambers BIBREF7 where people polarize their opinions as they are insulated from contrary perspectives.
